Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in its initial analysis by incorrectly identifying the name of the foundry. While the Planner correctly deduced that the location was Cold Spring, NY (across the Hudson from West Point), it confused the historical entity "West Point Foundry" with "West Point Foundry Association." The correct name of the 19th-century foundry is simply the "West Point Foundry." The "West Point Foundry Association" is a modern non-profit organization dedicated to preserving the site, not the name of the 19th-century industrial facility itself. This error was compounded when the Planner accepted the WebSurfer's search results (which correctly identified the "West Point Foundry") and incorrectly renamed it to "West Point Foundry Association" in the final answer.
